reason: Researched by web search. NVDA's -18% stop fired at 162.85 on 2026-11-13. Doing so would either add more AI-capex beta to a tape that is still breaking or force a mandate-marginal pick, and churn has a cost. The roughly 43% effective cash earning 4% is an acceptable place to wait out the binary print. Holding V, TSM and CME with their existing stops unchanged.
